evd_title: Pairwise GPT-4 feedback overlap dropped from 30.85% to 0.43% after shuffling confirming paper-specificity
finding: Pairwise GPT-4 feedback overlap dropped from 30.85% to 0.43% after shuffling confirming paper-specificity
P: 3,096 Nature-family papers (15 journals) and 1,709 ICLR 2022+2023 papers with human reviews
I: GPT-4 zero-shot feedback; extract-then-match pipeline; shuffle test within journal x category / conference year
C: Real vs shuffled GPT-4 feedback (null model)
O: Pairwise hit rate: Nature 30.85% -> 0.43%; ICLR 39.23% -> 3.91% (p<0.0001); global 57.55% -> 1.13% (Nature)
